item.title: 🔴 MALFEX npm Package 'imgdecode' Hides Shellcode Loader in Windows Native Addon
item.description:
Why this matters: Supply-chain risk — review third-party access and affected vendor dependencies.
Cybersecurity researchers have discovered a malicious npm package that's part of a recently disclosed software supply chain attack campaign dubbed MALFEX.
